confirmatory.hypothesis: Source-Gated Kinetic-TopoGuard versus Current-state ExtraTrees on event F1.
confirmatory.primary_decision_rule: superiority requires a positive paired mean event-F1 difference, a seed-bootstrap 95% confidence interval excluding zero, and a two-sided paired-permutation p-value below 0.05

frozen_feature_definitions.current: current and lagged component count, component-count change, node count, and active radius
frozen_feature_definitions.graph: degree, largest-component, clustering, path-length, and edge-density statistics without component-count state
frozen_feature_definitions.topology: zero-dimensional persistence image and fixed distribution summaries
frozen_feature_definitions.kinematic: current/projected pair-distance, velocity, projected-component, and radius-crossing summaries without component-count state

tie_break_order: minimum false alert events per minute

confirmatory.test_partition_role: single locked evaluation after all model and threshold choices

seed_selection.method: SHA-256 domain-separated counter stream; map first 64 digest bits to [100000, 2000099999], discard prior or duplicate seeds
